{c_important}Lightning Storm{/c} and {c_important}Lightning Bolt{/c} Critical Strikes have a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c} chance to spawn {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} {c_important}Dancing Bolts{/c} that seek enemies in the area dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Lightning Damage. 

Your {c_important}Dancing Bolts{/c} deal {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
